summary.outcome: Mongolia Parliament TV remains research-only. The official Parliament live/session page is a better user-facing route, but the SkyGo DASH endpoint is provider infrastructure without source-specific reuse permission or an Apple/web playback strategy.

prototype_policy: DASH records remain research-only unless source ownership, rights, and platform playback strategy are all documented.

families.reason: The official Parliament site publishes a live/session page with meeting video and YouTube references, while the SkyGo/GO+ evidence identifies a commercial OTT service carrying channels with official rights. No source-specific permission was found for third-party use of the SkyGo DASH manifest, and DASH remains outside the HLS-native playback path.
